name: SiteHeader
title: Templates/Headers/SiteHeader
summary: The marketing bar: a sticky `GlobalHeader` in its `site` placement. The surface runs to the window edges while the regions are capped at the bar’s own measure and centred, so the bar answers to the framed page under it. Start: the navigation trigger below `xl` and the brand. Middle: the navigation, from `xl`. End: Contact from `xl`, then Login and Start for free, with search last. The mega-menus and the navigation sheet are documented on Templates › Marketing › Shell › SiteNav. Built from `GlobalHeader`, `NavigationMenu`, `IconButton`, `Button` and `Brand`.
